construct: a THREE-layer elevation whose every layer colour is an OKLab spelling and whose last layer is an INSET hairline — the astryx `shadow-med` shape (examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json), minus the light-dark() mode fork the browser resolves at capture
why: An unparseable LAYER refuses the WHOLE stack by design (core/emit-figma-script.ts:1490-1491) — that is the right rule, and it is why one unreadable ok-space layer deleted the two elevation layers beside it. astryx's dropdown-menu and toast shipped `parsed neither as a single drop shadow nor as an effect stack — inexpressible / foreign shadow grammar` and floated white-on-white with no elevation at all. The inset layer is load-bearing too: Figma's INNER_SHADOW is a different effect type, so a stack that mixes them must survive as a stack.

canvas.note: two DROP_SHADOW layers plus one INNER_SHADOW hairline reach the node as an effect stack; a receipt naming the refusal is not a substitute for the ink
